review_scope: Independent local source-only review of the code-only staging template. No SSH, remote observations, payload reads, model/data access, tests, source changes, or staging were performed.

checks.name: new immutable source destination
checks.basis: The destination is derived as B/source-fg19-cache-<first-8-commit-hex>; payload source_root must equal that exact path. B and the new destination must exist/not be a symlink and lexists must show the destination absent. Staging uses mkdir followed by exclusive xb file creation. An existing or dangling-symlink destination fails closed; there is no overwrite path.

checks.name: source commit, manifest and staged code bytes
checks.basis: Before the first write, the template checks the embedded source-manifest SHA-256, commit and source_root, exact 167-entry manifest/file-map equality, allowed source path roots, and each base64 file's byte count and SHA-256. After writing, it checks the exact file-name set and re-hashes all 167 files. The template does not independently fetch/compare Git; root must render the payload from the confirmed published commit and verify the final embedded manifest/file map against that Git commit before invoking it.

checks.name: all admission checks precede the first filesystem write
checks.basis: Payload decoding and hash validation, B/destination/STOP_ADMISSION absence, read-only parent cgroup inspection, populated-descendant check, memory headroom check, physical-filesystem/free-space check, and a second destination absence check all occur before source.mkdir. No source metadata, run directory, cache, or evidence directory is created by this template.

checks.name: parent resource and populated-tree gate
checks.basis: The read-only systemctl show requires parent CPUQuotaPerSecUSec=2s, MemoryHigh=18,000,000,000, MemoryMax=20,000,000,000 and MemorySwapMax=0. It resolves the reported cgroup, bounds the cgroup.procs scan to fewer than 128 files, requires every listed process file empty, and requires memory.current + 128,000,000 < 17,000,000,000 before writing.

checks.name: physical disk and free-space gate
checks.basis: It requires more than 30 GiB available at B and checks findmnt -T B returns a filesystem type other than tmpfs or ramfs. B itself is rejected if symlinked.

checks.name: scope limited to code staging
checks.basis: The embedded source path filter permits only src/, scripts/, pyproject.toml and uv.lock; the code reads parent cgroup/control metadata and writes the newly named code snapshot. It does not read an old source tree, dataset arrays, checkpoints, model weights or cache outputs; it does not query or alter scientific units/jobs, GPU state, metadata, or campaign records.

checks.name: unknown staging outcome
checks.basis: A rerun against any existing destination aborts before writing. After an unknown prior outcome, root must inspect that exact destination read-only and classify it against the expected 167-file manifest before deciding on any next action; the template itself does not reconcile or repair an existing tree.

invocation_controls.review_note: The body rejects optimized Python via sys.flags.optimize, then installs RLIMIT_CPU and RLIMIT_AS inside main. Module import and the module-level embedded-payload base64/JSON decode occur before those in-process limits. The body also does not assert sys.flags.ignore_environment. To claim the requested whole-process controls, the root launch must invoke normal `python -E`, apply the 30-second outer timeout, and apply the CPU/address-space limits from process start (or have the source actor move payload decoding under the limits and root review the new template).

required_before_root_stage_call: Confirm the source actor's push and bind the actual new commit plus manifest SHA from the published Git bytes.
Render this exact template from that bound manifest; independently verify all 167 embedded files, source root, manifest SHA and rendered body SHA before execution.
Use normal `python -E`, an outer 30-second deadline, and process-start CPU/address-space limits consistent with the declared 5-second/128-MB envelope.
Recheck the fresh parent cgroup, empty populated tree, physical B filesystem with >30-GiB free, STOP_ADMISSION absence, and exact new destination absence immediately before staging.
If the invocation outcome is unknown, inspect the existing destination read-only; never blindly rerun or overwrite.
not_established: The future source commit, manifest digest, rendered body digest, and remote destination state are not known from this template review.
No source staging, CPU cache repair run, cache output, scientific job, or model result is admitted by this review.
